title: One label per unit
prompt: The packing station prints one label for every unit ordered, numbered within its order line. Write `solve(order_items)` so it returns one row per label.
rules: A line with `quantity` 3 gives three rows, with `unit_no` 1, 2 and 3.
A line with a `quantity` of 0 or less, or a missing quantity, gets no labels.
hints: Build an array that holds the product once per unit with `F.array_repeat`.
`F.posexplode` turns the array into rows and gives each one its position.
Positions start at 0, so `unit_no` is the position plus 1. `explode_outer` would keep lines that should print nothing.
